sourceSnapshot: Live Polymarket Gamma rules, Kalshi Trade API rules, synchronized books, public trade tapes and finalized outcomes through 2026-07-17.
warning: Approval asserts payoff equivalence, not order atomicity. Family-level records may reject but can never approve; approval requires exact condition and ticker ids after full rule review.

resolutionAudit.rationale: After the speech had begun inside both venue windows, reaching 30 minutes under Polymarket's shorter podium interval implied reaching 30 minutes under Kalshi's weakly longer first-to-last-audible-word interval. rejectionFamilies.polyEventTitle: How long will Trump’s Speech to the Nation be?
rejectionFamilies.rationale: Polymarket measures podium speech and excludes continued closing thanks, while Kalshi measures first audible word through last audible word and includes intervening pauses. Polymarket also assigns the lowest bracket after its cancellation/delay deadline; Kalshi states no identical fallback.

rejectionFamilies.polyEventTitle: 2026 Taiwanese Local Elections: Party Winner
rejectionFamilies.rationale: Polymarket specifies the included local governments, alphabetical tie-break, and June 30 available-results/Other fallback; Kalshi permits accelerated media calls and states none of those identical edge rules.

rejectionFamilies.polyEventTitle: World Cup: Most Player Goals Record Broken?
rejectionFamilies.rationale: Polymarket asks whether one player's 13-goal tournament record is broken; Kalshi asks whether players contracted to one club collectively score at least 20, 22, or 24 goals.

rejectionFamilies.polyEventTitle: World Cup: Player to score
rejectionFamilies.rationale: Polymarket pays Yes only for a goal in any World Cup match; Kalshi pays Yes for a goal or assist in one Spain–Argentina match and can settle an unused player at last fair market price.

rejectionFamilies.polyEventTitle: What song will be played first at the World Cup Halftime Show?
rejectionFamilies.rationale: Polymarket uses the first song sung by any official performer and requires lyrics; Kalshi uses Shakira's first qualifying song and accepts recognizable melody or lyrics. Their cancellation and unlisted-song handling also differ.

rejectionFamilies.polyEventTitle: Closest Senate Race?
rejectionFamilies.rationale: Polymarket selects the smallest victory margin across all qualifying US Senate elections; Kalshi selects the largest margin among only Georgia and North Carolina.

rejectionFamilies.polyEventTitle: Top artist in July?
rejectionFamilies.rationale: The ordinary Spotify metric, timestamp, and artist match, but Polymarket specifies alphabetical tie-break and most-recent-data handling during an outage; Kalshi states neither identical fallback and can determine through August 7.
